import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def test_json_output_mode():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "src/main.py", "--json"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
    assert payload == {"message": "Welcome, traveler."}


def test_default_text_mode():
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "src/main.py"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    )
    assert result.stdout == "Welcome, traveler.\n"

answer.summary: Added a dependency-free --json output mode to src/main.py while preserving the default text mode, and added an offline check in tests/test_json_output.py.
